nodes.summary: In the fixed-`q_L` limit the master sequence persists iff `μ < log σ`.
nodes.title: Eigen's error threshold

nodes.summary: For `σ > 1` and `Q ≤ 1` the interior equilibrium is at most `1`.
nodes.title: Interior quasispecies equilibrium is at most 1

nodes.summary: For `σ > 1`, the interior equilibrium is positive iff `σ Q > 1`.
nodes.title: Error threshold

nodes.summary: The interior equilibrium `x* = (σ Q - 1) / (σ - 1)` of the master frequency. For `σ = 1` (no selective advantage) Lean's `x / 0 = 0` gives the junk value `0`; every result below assumes `1 < σ`.
nodes.title: Interior equilibrium of the master-sequence frequency

nodes.summary: The equilibria of the master frequency are `0` and `x* = (σ Q - 1)/(σ - 1)`.
nodes.title: Equilibria of the master-sequence frequency

nodes.summary: The master-sequence equation is logistic: `x' = x ((σ Q - 1) - (σ - 1) x)`.
nodes.title: Master-sequence equation is logistic

nodes.summary: The master-sequence vector field of the single-peak quasispecies without back mutation: `x' = σ Q x - (σ x + (1 - x)) x`, where `σ` is the master fitness relative to the mutants and `Q` the probability of an error-free copy. Meaningful for `σ > 1`, `0 ≤ Q ≤ 1`, `0 ≤ x ≤ 1`; it is a polynomial and is defined for all reals.
nodes.title: Master-sequence vector field of the single-peak quasispecies

nodes.summary: For per-site fidelity `0 < q < 1` and `σ > 0`, `σ q ^ L > 1` iff `L < log σ / (-log q)`.
nodes.title: Maximal genome length

nodes.summary: The mutant frequency at the interior equilibrium is `1 - x* = σ (1 - Q)/(σ - 1)`.
nodes.title: Mutant frequency at the interior equilibrium

nodes.summary: With per-site fidelity `q_L = 1 - μ / L`, so that the expected number of mutations per genome copy is `μ`, the error-free probability is `q_L ^ L → e^{-μ}` and the master equilibrium converges to `(σ e^{-μ} - 1)/(σ - 1)`.
nodes.title: Fixed-`q_L` limit

nodes.summary: The interior equilibrium depends continuously on `Q`, so any sequence of fidelities with `Q_L → Qlim` has `x*(Q_L) → x*(Qlim)`.
nodes.title: Continuity of the interior equilibrium in the copying fidelity

nodes.summary: If `σ > 1`, `σ Q > 1` and `x` solves the master equation on `[0, ∞)` from a positive master frequency, then `x t → x*`.
nodes.title: Convergence above the threshold

nodes.summary: If `σ > 1`, `σ Q ≤ 1` and `x` solves the master equation on `[0, ∞)` from a positive master frequency, then `x t → 0`.
nodes.title: Loss of the master at or below the threshold

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
